muc.title: Copy the answer, stuck again tomorrow
muc.text: You ask AI a math problem, and it solves it right away, neat and correct. You copy it down and nod. The next day you get a similar problem, and you still can't do it.

muc.title: AI does the thinking for you
muc.text: The problem is that AI did the hardest part for you: the thinking. And that's exactly where learning happens.

muc.title: Asking back so you think
muc.text: Over two thousand years ago, Socrates taught by asking questions back, so his students would work out the answers themselves. This is called the Socratic method.

muc.title: Study mode
muc.text: Now the big AIs all have a mode like that: ChatGPT has Study mode, Gemini has Guided Learning, Claude has learning mode. AI gives hints and asks you questions, instead of handing over the answer.

muc.title: One prompt is enough
muc.text: If your app doesn't have this mode, no problem. One prompt is enough: don't give me the answer, ask me step by step so I can figure it out myself.

muc.title: Understanding, or just the result?
muc.text: Use it when you want to understand, like studying or preparing for exams. When you just need a quick result, like converting units, ask directly.

muc.title: The problem you're stuck on
muc.text: Pick an exercise you're stuck on, turn on study mode or paste the prompt: don't give me the answer, ask me step by step. Answer each question, and see how far you get on your own.

muc.title: Integrated learning
muc.text: The last part: integrated learning, combining several subjects in one real project.
